blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Anti-narcotics agents, backed by Philippine Marines and police, seized over P20.4 million worth of suspected shabu during a buy-bust operation in the seas off Tawi-Tawi on Monday, an official said. Abraham “Datu” Kalim, Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (PDEA-BARMM) Tawi-Tawi provincial officer, said that an alleged big-time drug peddler was arrested in another police operation following a high-speed water chase. He identified the leader of the five-man group as alias “Bradel.” The suspect’s group, who was aboard a speed boat, sold the suspected shabu to undercover agents on board a separate […]...
